summary: Blackstone Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K covering three items: a routine private placement of 278,469 Class I shares for $6.7M under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S, declaration of regular monthly distributions (June 2026: $0.20/sh for Class I, $0.183/sh for Class S; July: $0.18/sh gross), and NAV disclosure as of May 31, 2026 ($23.94/sh all classes). Aggregate NAV was $45.3B on $78.7B portfolio. No special-situation catalyst—capital raising is standard for a BDC/credit fund.
